messages:
sam: Quick heads-up: design review prep for the min/max stepper + burst-override control. I found a keyboard-only flow bug in the prototype, want to sync before tomorrow's meeting.

lina: Can you describe the repro or paste a short recording?

sam: Steps: Tab to the 'Min GPUs' stepper, press ArrowUp to increase. The value changes but focus moves to the burst toggle unexpectedly. If you press Enter on burst it opens a modal. Happens in Chrome and VoiceOver.

jorge: Likely focus management issue. Are we using `aria-live` or programmatic focus on value change?

sam: Prototype has an `aria-live` announcer for the new value and accidentally calls `focus()` on the burst toggle when value crosses a threshold.

rachel: That's rough. For accessibility we should avoid moving focus on value change unless the user explicitly requests a control. Users expect the stepper to keep focus.

lina: Agree. UX-wise, when the stepper hits max and we want to surface the burst override, we should show a subtle inline hint (e.g., inline text `Reached Max — consider Burst override`) + an optional `Learn more` link, not force focus.

jorge: Implementation suggestion: keep `aria-live` polite (not assertive) and do not call `focus()`. If we want to announce the state, use role="status" with aria-atomic="true".

sam: Good call. I'll change to polite and remove programmatic focus.

rachel: Copy suggestions for labels: use explicit units: 'Min GPUs (cores)' and 'Max GPUs (cores)'. Also change the stepper step size to 0.5 for fractional GPU configs and expose a tooltip that explains billing rounding.

lina: For microcopy on burst override: current copy says 'Allow bursts above max for short spikes'. Suggest shorter: 'Allow short bursts above Max (GPU cores/min)'. Keep the unit inline so users know what they're tuning.

jorge: Keyboard nav nit: burst override toggle must be reachable in logical order after Max stepper and marked with `aria-checked`. The burst duration dropdown should be a `select` element for screen reader compatibility.

a11y-bot: Automated check: burst toggle color contrast fails with the yellow accent on light theme (AA). Recommend using `#D8A600` or add a border when unchecked. Also ensure hit target >= 44px and label text has >4.5:1 contrast.

sam: Good catches. Action items: (1) remove programmatic focus, switch `aria-live` to polite; (2) label changes to include units and fractional step size; (3) burst UI -> toggle + select (native) + inline hint; (4) update visuals for color contrast & 44px hit target. I'll push a small PR with these changes.

rachel: One more UX question: should burst be a per-pool setting or global for the entire Dedicated capacity? Ops: per-pool is more flexible but more knobs for users.

lina: Maybe default to per-pool but add a banner in the picker if pools inherit a global setting. That helps enterprise customers who want a single control.

jorge: We'll need tests: keyboard-only walkthrough, screen reader narration check, and e2e assertions that focus does not leave the stepper on value change.

a11y-bot: Adding checklist: "Keyboard focus preserved on stepper changes", "Burst toggle uses native `button` or `input[type=checkbox]` with aria-checked", "Preset radios for SLO options use proper radio group markup", "Contrast and hit target verified".

sam: Thanks all — I'll iterate in Figma and link the updated prototype here when ready: https://www.figma.com/file/abc-proto-minmax. Plan to have PR by EOD. :thumbsup:
